description:
# Python Version Flexibility

Remove the Python 3.12 version lock by ensuring compatibility with Python 3.11-3.14. Create fallback mechanisms for dependencies lacking pre-built wheels on newer Python versions.

## Rationale
Technical debt item: Python 3.12 version lock. Improves user flexibility and future-proofing. Reduces installation friction for users with different Python versions installed.

## User Stories
- As a developer, I want to use my existing Python installation so that I don't have to manage multiple versions
- As a team member, I want to use the latest Python for security updates

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Python 3.11, 3.12, and 3.13 are supported
- [ ] Fallback to source compilation if pre-built wheels unavailable
- [ ] Clear error messages for unsupported Python versions
- [ ] CI tests on all supported Python versions
- [ ] Documentation clearly states version requirements
